title: Reticora domain event
description: Envelope of the domain events of EVT-01 to EVT-03, published on the NATS stream RETICORA_EVENTS under events.<org_id>.<type> and delivered to webhook subscriptions. Delivery is at least once: a consumer recognizes a repeated event by its id and processes the events of one entity in entity_seq order. A phase 2 type (EVT-03) names its entity, and its data follows its $defs entry.

id.description: Unique id of the event; the NATS message id.

occurred_at.description: When the mutation that raised the event was written.

sequence.description: Position of the event among the organization's events, in commit order without gaps.

entity_id.description: The entity the event concerns (for ci.* the CI id).

entity_seq.description: Position of the event among the events of its entity.

data.description: The event data; for ci.* the CI, for ci.changed with changed_fields; for a phase 2 type the frame of its $defs entry.

pii.description: Surrogate reference of a personal value (SEC-05, WP-241): data fields named after pii.IsPersonalKey carry it instead of the value.
